caption: The drawing features a collection of ornamental designs and architectural details rendered in watercolor. At the top, there is a horizontal frieze composed of a central rectangle with three large pink flowers with green leaves, flanked by two yellow urns on small plinths, each containing a red flower and green leaves, with additional red flowers and leaves extending horizontally. Below this frieze, in the upper middle section, there are two symmetrical pink and green vases/ovals with a leaf and vine pattern, positioned on either side of an architectural capital decorated with blue, red, and green elements, including a row of blue shapes within red circles, and a band of red diamonds on a gold background. In the center bottom, the main architectural elements are two stylized columns or capitals, each painted with stripes of red, blue, and a small amount of gold, with blue vertical lines at the base. Framing these, on either side, are two L-shaped corner border designs. The left border contains a blue Greek key pattern and a single blue flower on a gold background, and the right border contains a floral motif with small red and pink flowers and green leaves, with a single blue flower in one square. The entire composition is set against a plain, off-white background.
title: Details of Painted Decorations on Reredos and Walls
